name: Glassberry
summary: A growing and sales app for a glasshouse fruit farm, with live houses you can control
about: Glassberry runs a made-up fruit farm with four glasshouses of strawberries, tomatoes, blueberries, raspberries and melons. The houses are drawn live: fruit ripens, vents open, fans spin, water drips and readings react to what you switch. It also covers climate targets, plantings, the harvest log, orders, buyers, the cold store and daily tasks.
how: Click a glasshouse to open its vents, start the fans, heat, mist, shade or water it
Watch the temperature and humidity respond, and get an alarm if a house drifts out of range
Harvest the ripe fruit and see it land in the harvest log and cold store
Drag an order from new to packing, ready and delivered
Build a new order with several items and see the total update
Tick off tasks in each house and watch the progress rings fill
